info.name: Canvas Atkinson Hyperlegible Next
info.description:
Increase accessibility in Canvas by Instructure by changing the font from the default Lato to Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

YOU MUST INSTALL THE ATKINSON HYPERLEGIBLE NEXT FONT FAMILY TO YOUR PC FOR THIS TO WORK @ https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next
You may need to restart your computer
info.additionalInfo: Release V.1 designed for systems at the University of Florida
